asideNextText: Just need the list in a random order instead? The List Randomizer shuffles without grouping.
asideText: Everything is generated locally in your browser with cryptographic randomness. Nothing is uploaded, stored, or tracked.

faq.a: It uses your browser's cryptographic random generator (crypto.getRandomValues) with rejection sampling and unbiased shuffling — the same quality of randomness used by security software, not the predictable Math.random().
Entries are shuffled cryptographically, then dealt round-robin across the teams — so team sizes differ by at most one member, every time.
Team count is best when you know the format (4 teams). Team size is best for a target group size (about 5 per team) — the tool works out how many teams that makes.
faq.q: Should I pick team count or team size?

heroSubtitle: Paste the roster, choose your split, and get fair random teams in one click.
metaDescription: Split any list of names into random, balanced teams. Choose the number of teams or the team size — sizes never differ by more than one. Free, private.
title: Random Team Generator — Split a List into Teams | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: Random teams ignore skill, friendships, and conflicts — for competitive leagues, seed or draft first and use this only to break the remaining ties.
It can't balance by attributes (age, level) because it deliberately treats every entry equally.
